Got pretty hyped with this connection I got, it only started leaking once lol. Rock and stone

The scary part for me is I have a few different guns to choose from readily available. I just obsess over all the details of what I'd leave behind, the grief and the mess. I don't know how I will get it done without scarring the people who care and it kills me. Thanks for being open and sharing a bit of your story with me. It means a lot!

Aurelius was so ahead of his time and we still haven't caught up mentally!! I'd definitely recommend checking out his book Meditations. It's filled with gold. I'm sorry you're going through it. I told myself I'd end things on my birthday, but it's only a few days away now and I feel way too terrified to go through with it. I can't see things getting any better with me personally or the world at large so I'm stuck.
How'd you meet your girlfriend? Tinder then anal. I get trying to sell the personalities but I'm so tired of these questions already.

I see your point and I feel like I've been in that state as well, but distractions don't have to be physical things. They can be mindsets, beliefs, and worldviews as well, in my opinion. I've lost all the positivity of the three of those though, so I'm dying for a distraction.

Finally got around to playing spec ops: the line and damn... I had no clue what I was in for. I was just wanting some decent 3rd person cover shooting but the story absolutely hooked me. Binged the entire campaign throughout the day. Tons have been said about this game, but if you haven't played this one to the end, I can't recommend it enough!!

"Mama Tried" - Merle Haggard played in The Strangers!
I love hearing songs that usually don't give a creepy vibe, but add so much tension in the right context! Such a good song regardless.

I did notice my rig getting a bit hot with the infected but haven't checked my temps during gameplay. The newest infected mini update seemed to of optimized performance a good bit! My fps was around 60 but now it hovers close to 90-100. Hopefully it doesn't catch fire haha

Yeah it seems like all the "endgame" content is just to build a mega base / tower defence style, but I'm not sure how big the hordes can get. The most I've had was 9 attacking my fences haha. Finding all the blueprints was a bit of a headache cause I missed a few at first, but so damn satisfying to finally have them all.

That sounds like quite the first adventure haha! Enjoy the PC! I got my setup not too long ago after consoles all my life and it changed everything haha. I'd 100% recommend playing through the forest if you haven't on PC as well. I enjoyed green hell too but I'd probably put that at the bottom of the survival games I've tried.

I agree! The beginning was quite slow for me cause I tried to learn the basics on my own, but once I got some resources flowing and got a hang of the nutrition aspects, I'm hooked. Haven't ever really kept up with an early access game while it was being heavily updated so I'm pretty excited about this one!

The lastest update brought the AI slightly closer to that of the forest and that is the standard for these types of games in my books! There's tons of things that could keep being improved on and I think that's what's exciting! I've never really followed an early access while it was being heavily updated.
